annotations.title: What a claim denial code means

description: What an insurance or Medicare denial code on an explanation of benefits means: a Claim Adjustment Reason Code (e.g. CO-97, PR-1, 197) or a Remark Code (e.g. M15, N432), from the X12 code lists. With a prefix it says whether the person may owe the amount (CO is the provider's write-off, PR is patient responsibility); for common codes it gives the typical fix and who acts. Not legal or billing advice.

code.description: The code as printed, e.g. CO-97, PR-204, 50 or N432.
